name: ppe
role: PPE compliance - head (bare head = NO HELMET) / helmet detection inside a padded person crop
licence_note: Trained outside this repository (demo_package.zip, model_id final_C_v2). Architecture YOLOX-Nano (Apache-2.0). Training data per the package's model_card.md: Hard Hat Workers (CC0), SHEL5K (CC BY 4.0), Roboflow Construction Site Safety v30 (CC BY 4.0) - CC BY 4.0 sources require attribution at distribution (NOTICE.md section 5). Dataset licences are as stated by the package, not independently re-verified here.
source: demo_package.zip (model_card.md: 'final_C_v2 (recipe C, 60 epochs warm-start, val_v2 AP50 96.0)')
datasets: Roboflow Construction Site Safety v30 (CC BY 4.0)
trained_at: not recorded in demo_package.zip (recipe: 60 epochs warm-started from the 20-epoch arm-C ablation; torch 2.6.0+cu124, GTX 1650)

preprocessing.crop: person box padded x 0.10, top 0.12, bottom 0.04 of its own size, clamped to the frame; people shorter than 96 px are not checked
preprocessing.resize: letterbox to 320x320, pad value 114, ratio = min(H_in/h, W_in/w), top-left placement

validation: model_card.md val_v2 (4,607 person crops): colour AP50 96.0, head P/R 93.4/90.2, helmet P/R 96.9/93.3. Weak on black/grey helmets (74% recall) and green (n=22). No vest/gloves/shoes/glasses.
